selection: All paired images in both named archives, across all publisher partitions, before scores. No performance-based exclusions.

reference.mask_values: 0 background; 1 foreground (0/255 binary masks also supported with recorded encoding)
reference.oracle_geometry: Union of foreground x projections, full image height, no reference y centers or per-band windows. Diagnostic only: uses reference geometry, merges x-overlapping lanes, cannot test empty-lane specificity.

evaluation.matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching of candidate centers to connected reference foreground components within a Euclidean native-pixel-center tolerance. Tie-break minimizes distance to foreground pixels. All candidates and all reference components count.
evaluation.reference_role: Published annotated foreground components, not known biological loci or exact unambiguous band truth.

interpretation: External source transfer of point detection. Not full segmentation Dice, RAPD genotype accuracy, taxonomic transfer, or a head-to-head GelGenie model comparison. Height-normalized and reference-geometry results remain separate diagnostics.
